Wishlist.title: User Saved Collection (Wishlist)
Wishlist.description: Represents the items favorited and saved by a user

productIds.description: List of saved product IDs or names

updatedAt.description: The ISO timestamp when the saved collection was last updated

MainCategory.title: Main Category
MainCategory.description: Represents a high-level catalog category like Fashion, Health and Beauty, or Electronics

names.description: Multi-lingual names dictionary e.g. {en, ar, fr}

Subcategory.title: Subcategory
Subcategory.description: Represents a specific category belonging to a main category, which contains dynamic specification fields and sizing rules

names.description: Multi-lingual names dictionary e.g. {en, ar, fr}

Brand.title: Brand
Brand.description: Represents a brand under a high-level category with approved models

PendingModel.title: Pending Model
PendingModel.description: Represents a model submitted by user for review and approval

/wishlists/{userId}.description: Saves and persists user's saved wishlist collection

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Saves and manages high-level product catalog main categories

/subcategories/{subcategoryId}.description: Saves and manages subcategories containing specialized attributes and schemas

/brands/{brandId}.description: Saves and manages brands with official approved models

/pending_models/{pendingModelId}.description: Saves and manages custom models pending review
